regionSummary: Pomeranian Voivodeship is Poland's first-NPP region: the PPEJ names PEJ/Westinghouse AP1000 deployment, Lubiatowo-Kopalino is the selected coastal site [pl-ppej], and Polish Atomic Law provides the PAA licensing pathway [pl-prawo-atomowe].
